overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the council president, as chair, had discretion under G.L. c. 30A, § 20(f) to refuse a member of the public permission to address the February 28, 2012 open forum, though the AG encouraged allowing public participation where reasonably possible.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the council president wrongly stopped him from speaking during open forum at the February 28, 2012 meeting, then adjourned the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the law permits the chair of a public body to determine who may address the public body during a meeting, the Council President, as the chair of the Council, had discretion to deny members of the public the opportunity to speak during the February 28, 2012 meeting.
